settings.heading: Our Story
settings.subheading: Building sustainable bicycles and stronger communities

settings.text:
In 2012, James Marr returned from Canada with an unusual skill — the ability to build bicycle frames from bamboo. He opened a small workshop in London with a simple mission: teach others this craft.

What started as weekend workshops has grown into a global movement. Over 4,000 people across 36 countries have now built their own bamboo bicycles, each one as unique as its maker.

settings.label: The Team
settings.heading: Meet the Team
settings.intro: From London to Toulouse to Amersfoort — united by a shared belief that everyone should have the chance to build something meaningful with their hands.

settings.name: James Marr
settings.bio: James learned to build bamboo bicycles in Canada before returning to London to share this knowledge. He leads BBC's mission to make sustainable craftsmanship accessible to all — from corporate teams to schools to prisons.

settings.name: Toulouse Workshop
settings.bio: BBC's French home, bringing bamboo bike building to the heart of cycling country. Workshops available in French and English.

settings.name: Amersfoort Workshop
settings.bio: Our Dutch workshop serving the Netherlands and surrounding regions. Building a thriving community of European bamboo bike builders.

settings.title: Sustainability
settings.text: Bamboo absorbs 35% more CO₂ than trees and regrows in 3-5 years. Our frames produce 56.7% less carbon than aluminium.

settings.title: Craftsmanship
settings.text: We teach traditional handcraft skills in a modern context, helping people reconnect with making things with their hands.

settings.title: Community
settings.text: From our London workshop to prisons to schools, we build more than bikes — we build confidence, skills, and connections.

settings.heading: Our Journey
settings.intro: From a small London workshop to a global community of builders.

settings.title: BBC Founded
settings.description: James and Ian open the first bamboo bicycle workshop in London, teaching people to build their own sustainable frames.

settings.title: DIY Kits Launch
settings.description: We launch our first home build kits, making bamboo bike building accessible to people everywhere.

settings.title: Design Museum Exhibition
settings.description: Our work is featured in the Cycle Revolution exhibition at the Design Museum.

settings.title: Kevin McCloud's Green Heroes
settings.description: Selected for eco-friendly product design at Grand Designs Live.

settings.title: Build to Bond Launches
settings.description: Our flagship prison rehabilitation programme begins at HMP Lowdham Grange, helping parents build bicycles for their children.

settings.title: Investec Beyond Business
settings.description: Recognised for our educational work in prisons, helping parents maintain family connections.

settings.text: Our impact extends far beyond the workshop. Through Build to Bond, we help prisoners build bicycles as gifts for their children — creating tangible connections that last beyond prison walls. Our educational programmes bring hands-on STEM learning to schools and alternative education providers.

settings.heading: Our Global Community
settings.subheading: Building bikes and connections around the world

settings.text: Whether you want to build at home with one of our kits, join a workshop in London, or bring bamboo bike building to your organisation — we're here to help you get started.
